name: Omni First Steps
summary:
Take your first steps into full-body VR.

First Steps is the guided introduction to Omni One, Virtuix's full-body VR gaming system. Explore beautiful environments as you learn how to walk, turn, and move on Omni One.

Designed for new users, First Steps provides a simple and enjoyable introduction to full-body VR movement and helps you get comfortable before jumping into your favorite games. Wander through ancient Roman ruins, stroll the streets of a charming Paris neighborhood, and test your confidence cro
